title: Renoprotective effects of ACE inhibitors in chronic kidney disease
text: In patients with chronic kidney disease, ACE inhibitors slow the progression of renal function decline by reducing intraglomerular pressure and proteinuria. These renoprotective effects are particularly pronounced in patients with diabetic nephropathy and are considered independent of blood-pressure-lowering effects.
